name: Tarleinn's Falls
hours: Open; an hour up the jungle trail. Deserted on weekdays.
sight: The stream that feeds the campus drops thirty metres here over a lip of black basalt into a round green pool, and the whole clearing breathes spray. Rainbows stand in it on sunny mornings. Ferns grow out of the cliff sideways; a flat rock in the middle of the pool is warm as a cat. The noise wipes your head clean.
things: Swim in the plunge pool, which is cold enough to make you shout
Sit on the flat rock and dry off
Climb the wet path up the side to the lip
Go behind the curtain of water into the hollow at the back
Fill a bottle — it is the best water on the island
Bring a deck and play on the flat rock with the spray curling the cards
Come at the right hour for the rainbow
secret: Romantic and restful (several routes' 'first real day out'). Named by Chuck after his favourite hero; behind the curtain, the back wall of the hollow is a mosaic panel two metres high, bright because the spray keeps it clean: a traveller with a staff and a pack walking a road of squares. Rowan, whose deck is led by Tarleinn the Traveler, will recognise the silhouette at once — the first moment the player may suspect the cards depict someone. Viktor has rubbed it; Chuck will only say 'Good likeness, isn't it? He never did hold still.' After D27 the plunge pool is a degree warmer each week.
